fields.name: Quizlet Gravity: Play & Learn
fields.subtitle: Flashcards & leaderboards
fields.promotional-text: Learn by playing games. Choose a game, import a Quizlet set or create your own. Share games and challenge friends on the leaderboard.
fields.description:
Learn by playing games. Challenge friends on the leaderboard.

Try the example game with one tap, choose a shared game, or search by title or creator. Type answers before falling asteroids reach your planet.

CREATE, IMPORT & SHARE
Create a game with your own terms, answers and images, or upload a CSV. Import a public Quizlet set, including supported images, or edit it to make your own game. Share a game link with friends.

PLAY YOUR WAY
Choose your difficulty and practise with terms, definitions or both. Star cards to focus on the ones you want to learn.

LEARN FROM MISTAKES
Miss an asteroid and practise the correct answer. Watch out for red asteroids: missing one ends the game.

CHALLENGE FRIENDS
Play with a guest username or an account. Your highest score for each shared game appears on its leaderboard.

An internet connection is required. Quizlet imports depend on the source set being public and accessible.

Quizlet Gravity is an independent project and is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Quizlet.
fields.review-notes:
Quizlet Gravity is a flashcard-based typing game for iPhone, iPad and Mac. It requires an internet connection and loads the production service at https://www.quizletgravity.com/.

To review without registering:
1. Select Try Example Game on the landing page. It starts immediately and requires no account.
2. Type answers to the arithmetic questions on the asteroids. Exit returns to the games page.
3. Alternatively choose a shared game, create your own game, or import a public Quizlet set.
4. Missing a term opens the correct-answer step. Missing a red asteroid ends the game.

For shared-set leaderboards, choose a guest username, open a shared set and select Play this game. Account registration uses email verification. Google and Sign in with Apple are also offered. Account deletion is available from Your account → Delete account. Deleted accounts retain anonymised leaderboard scores as Deleted user. No purchases or subscriptions are sold in the app.

The Mac app supports Intel and Apple silicon. It uses a desktop layout and physical keyboard input. CSV import uses the system file picker.

Review contact: quizletgravity@gmail.com

User safety: shared sets and leaderboard entries offer reporting and personal blocking. Blocked users can be managed from Your account. Administrators review reports in the moderation queue.
